data.description:
## Description

What: Make the dso-llm reviewer's accepted-defense write path RECORD the originating review comment's github_comment_id on the defense record it persists (consuming the optional additive field added in draft-4), and establish the explicit cross-epic requirement that the b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (swap-maple-flyby) arbiter likewise supplies github_comment_id on its DROP/DEFER/accept defense writes. Today draft-4 only makes both writers ACCEPT the field and draft-5 only RESOLVES it when present; no story SUPPLIES it on a real write, so only the graceful-skip path is exercised. This story closes the populated-field happy path: the dso-llm resolver threads the comment id from the review-comment thread it is defending against into the defense-store write, and an integration test proves that a live (non-mocked) accepted-defense produces a defense record with a non-null github_comment_id that the draft-5 auto-resolve adapter then consumes to dispatch resolveReviewThread. Why: sc-3 and sc-4 require the populated-field happy path (a real write -> a real resolution), not merely the skip-when-absent branch. Scope IN: dso-llm accepted-defense write path populates github_comment_id from the originating review comment; explicit cross-epic coordination requirement that b575 arbiter populates the same field; the live (non-mocked) integration test producing a non-null-id record that draft-5 resolves. Scope OUT: the defense-record schema field itself (draft-4); the resolveReviewThread adapter logic (draft-5); the arbiter ruling logic (lives in b575).


## Done Definitions

- The dso-llm reviewer's accepted-defense write path records the originating review comment's github_comment_id on the persisted defense record, producing a non-null github_comment_id for a defended_accepted outcome that originated from a review-comment thread ← Satisfies: sc-4
- An explicit cross-epic requirement is documented (in plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md) that the b575-ac1c-f720-4839 arbiter populates github_comment_id on its DROP/DEFER/accept defense writes, using the same field name and type locked with draft-4 ← Satisfies: sc-3
- A live (non-mocked) accepted-defense flow produces a defense record with a non-null github_comment_id which the draft-5 defense-store-to-thread-resolve adapter consumes to dispatch a resolveReviewThread mutation against the matched thread (happy path, not the graceful-skip branch) ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- An integration test exercises the dso-llm accepted-defense write -> defense-store -> auto-resolve chain in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) and asserts the produced record has a non-null github_comment_id that the adapter resolves ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4

## Considerations

- [Cross-epic] The b575-ac1c-f720-4839 arbiter is the other producer of github_comment_id on defense writes; this story documents and coordinates that requirement but does not ship the arbiter's code. Confirm the field name/type (locked in draft-4) matches what b575 writes.
- [Dependency] This story consumes the optional github_comment_id field added in draft-4 and is consumed by draft-5 (and draft-8) which resolve threads only when the field is non-null; without this story those stories exercise only the graceful-skip branch.
- [Happy-path] The point of this story is to exercise the POPULATED path end-to-end; the test must assert a non-null id and an actual mutation dispatch, not merely that the skip-when-absent branch logs INFO.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want dso-llm accepted-defense writes (and, cross-epic, the b575 arbiter) to populate github_comment_id on the defense record
